This mushroom is found chiefly in cool temperate climates, especially in underground environments, and is best known throughout Endor. Even in suitable terrain, it remains of medium difficulty to find.

The active substance of Luminous Vrak is taken from beneath the fungus's gills. When applied to a wound it gradually reduces bleeding until it stops, over several minutes. The effect is not immediate, so a healer must continue watching a wound that is still bleeding during the first moments of treatment.
